title: A long render can fill the disk
mitigation: Thesium estimates the size of a native image sequence and stops with a clear message before the drive fills.

title: Whisper misses a name the model invented
mitigation: Thesium gives the transcription a second pass with the capitalised words. Words still missed show the phonemes Kokoro used.

title: EffectCraft masters are slow
mitigation: Thesium renders half-scale previews while building. The showcase film's 30 s master took 527 s on a 12-thread Windows machine.

title: A film depends on a model session that can stop
mitigation: The film folder holds the plan, the source and the evidence, so `thesium make --continue` resumes where the session stopped.
